deploy-bot: PROMOTION PAUSED: release v2.15.0 -> staging. Pipeline 'release-candidate' failed step 'build-and-verify' on runner build-9.
Nikhil: build step failed during cache upload, saw lots of HTTP 499/connection reset spikes to our cache service.
Priya: logs?
Nikhil: tail:
```
2026-04-01T14:02:11Z [cache-upload] WARN: chunk upload failed: connection reset
2026-04-01T14:02:11Z [cache-upload] RETRY 1/3
2026-04-01T14:02:12Z [cache-upload] WARN: upload completed but reported size mismatch (expected 204800, got 204799)
2026-04-01T14:02:12Z [build] ERROR: cache verify failed -> abort
```
Diego: off-by-one again during streaming. We fixed a similar client-side buffer handling earlier but maybe it regressed.
ops-oncall: I'm looking at cache nodes; one node in us-central shows kernel OOM and was evicted around 14:01. Could have caused truncated uploads.
Priya: change window is open for another 30m. Options: 1) revert to last pinned build (v2.14.9) to unblock promotions, 2) re-run build after clearing bad cache nodes, 3) force-accept cache artifact with manual approve.
Nikhil: prefer re-run after evict/restart cache node and re-upload. That avoids an unnecessary rollback. But if we can't recover quickly, pinning last good is safest for customer apps.
Diego: I can roll the problematic cache node now, should be <8m. After that, we can re-run the build job with --no-cache to ensure a fresh upload then resume integrate.
Priya: agree rollback/pin only if re-run fails. Can someone annotate release to prevent auto-retry?
deploy-bot: Annotated release v2.15.0 with tag `hold:cache-upload-truncate`. Manual resume required.
ops-oncall: I've drained the node and restarted the cache service. Watching for new uploads.
Nikhil: re-triggering build with `BUILDKITE_DISABLE_CACHE=false --artifact-verify` now, forcing fresh chunks.
Priya: if the rebuild passes, we should also add a CI guard for verifying object size at upload completion to fail fast and include node id in logs.
Diego: agree; will open a quick PR after this.
Nikhil: build finished and artifact verify passed on rerun. Re-triggering release-candidate integration.
Priya: integrate passed. Deploybot, resume promotion please.
deploy-bot: Promotion resumed for v2.15.0 -> staging after manual confirmation.
Diego: follow-up actions: 1) add upload-complete size/assert in cache client, 2) alert on cache node OOMs more aggressively, 3) add a short pause after publish before CI fetch to allow mirror propagation.
Priya: adding a release note entry: "Incident: transient cache node OOM caused truncated uploads and build verification failures; node restarted and artifacts re-published; no rollback."
Nikhil: marking this resolved for now. Keep an eye on next few builds.
